infra.gpu_id_note: Verify exact --gpu-id strings against `runpodctl gpu list` at launch; 'NVIDIA L4' is confirmed from 2026-08-28.

runs.note: Completed 2026-08-28 on RTX 4090 pod 8w09mq198ctjw4. AUROC 0.8276, AUPRC 0.1366, TPR@5%FPR 0.4127, TPR@top-5% 0.3875.

failure_policy.crash_or_nan: Report the log tail verbatim and halt. Do not retry, do not modify flags.
failure_policy.gpu_out_of_stock: Fall through gpu_preference_order once. If none available, report and halt; do not pick a GPU outside the list.
failure_policy.ssh_drop_mid_run: Reconnect and recover state from the run log; the process keeps running (detached launch).
failure_policy.budget_exceeded: Stop launching. Pull any finished outputs, delete the pod, report.

end_of_session: scp checkpoints + train_<run>.log + train_<run>.meta.json to local lightning_logs/<run>/
fill notes/runs.md with the faithful-recording block for each run
runpodctl pod delete (requires approve-pod-delete), confirm `runpodctl pod list` is []
